name: Dongwon Metal Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1971 and headquartered in Gyeongsan-si, South Korea, Dongwon Metal Co., Ltd. operates as a global manufacturer and supplier of diverse automotive components and various steel pipe products, serving markets across the United States, Europe, and Asia. The company's automotive product line encompasses critical structural elements such as door frames, internal door assemblies, bumper and impact beams, cowl cross members, and battery frames, alongside fem carriers and a range of roll-formed and pressed items. Beyond physical parts, Dongwon Metal also engineers and supplies specialized manufacturing equipment, including roll forming, bending, welding jig, and saw cutting machines, as well as comprehensive automatic production line systems. Its extensive catalog of steel pipes caters to numerous applications, featuring structural pipes for specific purposes, aluminum-galvanized pipes for vehicle construction, standard square and rectangular structural pipes, stainless steel pipes designed for fuel gas systems, high corrosion resistance pipes, and specialized pipes for hydroforming. The company further provides carbon steel, C section, and spiral weld steel pipes.
